arxiv-2305-05015.title: A Low-Mass Helium Star Progenitor Model for the Type Ibn SN 2020nxt
arxiv-2305-05015.creator: Qinan Wang, Anika Goel, Luc Dessart, Ori D. Fox, Melissa Shahbandeh, Sofia Rest, Armin Rest, Jose H. Groh, Andrew Allan, Claes Fransson, Nathan Smith, Griffin Hosseinzadeh, Alexei V. Filippenko, Jennifer Andrews, K. Azalee Bostroem, Thomas G. Brink, Peter Brown, Jamison Burke, Roger Chevalier, Geoff
arxiv-2305-05015.description: Abstract A growing number of supernovae (SNe) are now known to exhibit evidence for significant interaction with a dense, pre-existing, circumstellar medium (CSM). SNe Ibn comprise one such class that can be characterised by both rapidly evolving light curves and persistent narrow He i lines.

arxiv-2306-12463.title: Turán numbers of general hypergraph star forests Thanks: Supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (No.12271439) and China Scholarship Council (No. 202206290003).
arxiv-2306-12463.creator: Lin-Peng Zhang, Hajo Broersma, Ligong Wang
arxiv-2306-12463.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Lin-Peng Zhang, Hajo Broersma, Ligong Wang. Abstract Let \mathcal{F} be a family of r -uniform hypergraphs, and let H be an r -uniform hypergraph. Then H is called \mathcal{F} -free if it does not contain any member of \mathcal{F} as a subhypergraph. The Turán number of \mathcal{F} , denoted by ex_{r}(n,\mathcal{F}) , is the maximum number of hyperedges in an \mathcal{F} -free n -vertex r -uniform hypergraph.

arxiv-2309-09697.title: Evaluating Gender Bias of Pre-trained Language Models in Natural Language Inference by Considering All Labels * This paper describes work performed at Tokyo Institute of Technology and is not associated with MBZUAI.
arxiv-2309-09697.description: Abstract Discriminatory gender biases have been found in Pre-trained Language Models (PLMs) for multiple languages. In Natural Language Inference (NLI), existing bias evaluation methods have focused on the prediction results of one specific label out of three labels, such as neutral. However, such evaluation methods can be inaccurate since unique biased inferences are associated with unique prediction labels.

arxiv-2409-08882.title: Quantitative propagation of chaos for non-exchangeable diffusions via first-passage percolation Thanks: D.L. and F.Z. acknowledge support from the NSF CAREER award DMS-2045328.
arxiv-2409-08882.creator: Daniel Lacker, Lane Chun Yeung, and Fuzhong Zhou
arxiv-2409-08882.description: Abstract . This paper develops a non-asymptotic approach to mean field approximations for systems of n n diffusive particles interacting pairwise. The interaction strengths are not identical, making the particle system non-exchangeable. The marginal law of any subset of particles is compared to a suitably chosen product measure, and we find sharp relative entropy estimates between the two.

arxiv-2412-18546.title: The massive fast spinning white dwarf in the HD 49798/RX J0648.0–4418 binary
arxiv-2412-18546.creator: Sandro Mereghetti
arxiv-2412-18546.description: Abstract I review the properties and discuss some of the puzzling aspects of the unique binary system composed of the luminous hot subdwarf HD 49798 and a white dwarf with mass of 1.2 M ⊙ ~M_{\odot} and spin period of 13.2 s.

arxiv-2503-14938.title: Optimal Transport Adapter Tuning for Bridging Modality Gaps in Few-Shot Remote Sensing Scene Classification
arxiv-2503-14938.creator: Zhong JI, Ci LIU, Jingren LIU, Chen TANG, Yanwei PANG, Xuelong LI
arxiv-2503-14938.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zhong JI, Ci LIU, Jingren LIU, Chen TANG, Yanwei PANG, Xuelong LI. Few-Shot Remote Sensing Scene Classification (FS-RSSC) presents the challenge of classifying remote sensing images with limited labeled samples. Existing methods typically emphasize single-modal feature learning, neglecting the potential benefits of optimizing multi-modal representations. To address this limitation, we propose a novel Optimal Transport Adapter Tuning (OTAT) framework aimed at constructing an ideal Platonic representational space through optimal transport (OT) theory.

arxiv-2602-17933.title: Comparison of security mechanisms of Mathematical cipher, Wyner scheme, QKD, and Quantum stream cipher
arxiv-2602-17933.creator: Gikyu Yamamoto 1 , Osamu Hirota 1,2,3
arxiv-2602-17933.description: Abstract A new generation of global communications technology has been emerging. These systems, which utilize established device technologies and quantum effect devices, require ultra-high speeds, low cost, and strong security. In recent years, global communication systems have faced various practical security challenges depending on their configurations, and research efforts are underway to address these issues.

plos-pone-0007305.creator: Shafiq Uddin Ahmed, Jo Milner
plos-pone-0007305.description: PLOS ONE research article. The regulation of apoptosis under basal (non-stress) conditions is crucial for normal mammalian development and also for normal cellular turnover in different tissues throughout life. Deficient regulation of basal apoptosis, or its perturbation, can result in impaired development

pmc-10691915.title: Spleen-Derived CCL9 Recruits MDSC to Facilitate Tumor Growth in Orthotopic Hepatoma Mice
pmc-10691915.creator: Baohua Li, Wenjuan Li, Yingxue Liang, Chen Zhang, Guangyao Kong, Zongfang Li
pmc-10691915.description: Objectives Spleen is involved in multiple diseases, the role of the spleen and spleen-derived factors in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is still not clarified. Methods In the current study, a murine H22 orthotopic hepatoma model was established. Three groups were divided: normal mice, tumor-bearing mice with spleen-preserving, and tumor-bearing mice with splenectomy.

pmc-10747371.title: Eriocitrin Disrupts Erythrocyte Membrane Asymmetry through Oxidative Stress and Calcium Signaling and the Activation of Casein Kinase 1α and Rac1 GTPase
pmc-10747371.creator: Sumiah A Alghareeb, Jawaher Alsughayyir, Mohammad A Alfhili, Yuan-Yen Chang
pmc-10747371.description: Background: Hemolysis and eryptosis result in the premature elimination of circulating erythrocytes and thus contribute to chemotherapy-related anemia, which is extremely prevalent in cancer patients. Eriocitrin (ERN), a flavanone glycoside in citrus fruits, has shown great promise as an anticancer agent, but the potential toxicity of ERN to human erythrocytes remains unstudied.

pmc-10830765.title: Multiple sclerosis clinical forms classification with graph convolutional networks based on brain morphological connectivity
pmc-10830765.creator: Enyi Chen, Berardino Barile, Françoise Durand-Dubief, Thomas Grenier, Dominique Sappey-Marinier
pmc-10830765.description: Multiple Sclerosis (MS) is an autoimmune disease that combines chronic inflammatory and neurodegenerative processes underlying different clinical forms of evolution, such as relapsing-remitting, secondary progressive, or primary progressive MS. This identification is usually performed by clinical evaluation at the diagnosis or during the course of the disease for the secondary progressive phase.

pmc-11297596.title: Bruton’s tyrosine kinase inhibition ameliorated neuroinflammation during chronic white matter ischemia
pmc-11297596.creator: Lu-Lu Xu, Sheng Yang, Luo-Qi Zhou, Yun-Hui Chu, Xiao-Wei Pang, Yun-Fan You, Hang Zhang, Lu-Yang Zhang, Li-Fang Zhu, Lian Chen, Ke Shang, Jun Xiao, Wei Wang, Dai-Shi Tian, Chuan Qin
pmc-11297596.description: Chronic cerebral hypoperfusion (CCH), a disease afflicting numerous individuals worldwide, is a primary cause of cognitive deficits, the pathogenesis of which remains poorly understood. Bruton’s tyrosine kinase inhibition (BTKi) is considered a promising strategy to regulate inflammatory responses within the brain, a crucial process that is assumed to drive ischemic demyelination progression.

pmc-12093566.title: Challenges and opportunities to integrate artificial intelligence in radiation oncology: a narrative review
pmc-12093566.creator: Chiyoung Jeong, YoungMoon Goh, Jungwon Kwak
pmc-12093566.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming various medical fields, including radiation oncology. This review explores the integration of AI into radiation oncology, highlighting both challenges and opportunities. AI can improve the precision, efficiency, and outcomes of radiation therapy by optimizing treatment planning, enhancing image analysis, facilitating adaptive radiation therapy, and enabling predictive analytics.

pmc-12556283.title: Scaling up a psychological intervention for alcohol misuse in wartime: a qualitative study in Ukraine
pmc-12556283.creator: K Antia, C Van Der Boor, O Biklian, V Kachay, S Bogdanov, B Roberts, D Fuhr
pmc-12556283.description: BackgroundThe war in Ukraine has intensified mental health vulnerabilities, including alcohol misuse among conflict-affected men. The CHANGE intervention, a new transdiagnostic intervention building on WHO's Problem Management Plus (PM+), aims to address alcohol misuse and common mental disorders. This study explores the scalability of CHANGE within Ukraine's war-affected health system.

pmc-13106401.title: Case Report: Unilateral biportal endoscopic removal of migrated posterior lumbar interbody cages: a technical note
pmc-13106401.creator: Wei Cheng, Dongmei Liu, Hailin Liang, Jiaming Liang, Chengyue Zhu, Rongxue Shao, Dong Wang, Hao Pan, Wei Zhang
pmc-13106401.description: ObjectiveRevision surgery for the removal of a migrated interbody fusion cage is challenging due to scar tissue formation in the surgical area. This study introduces a unilateral biportal endoscopic (UBE) technique for the removal of a migrated fusion cage and reports the patient's clinical outcomes.

pmc-13161859.title: Temporary Fusionless Occipitocervical Fixation of Bilateral Occipital Condylar Avulsion Fractures in an Adult
pmc-13161859.creator: Guillermo Rodriguez, Juliana Gomez, Daniel Cavazos, Rahul Vaidya
pmc-13161859.description: Introduction:Occipital condyle fractures (OCFs) are rare injuries presenting with neurologic sequelae that may be debilitating or even fatal. Treatment options for unstable OCFs include fusion or halo placement. Fusion of the occipitocervical junction is associated with a significant loss of motion.

pmc-13176789.title: Clinico-Hematological and Immunophenotypic Profile of Leukemia Patients at a Tertiary Care Center in Jharkhand, India: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13176789.creator: Abhirup Shome, Manoj K Paswan, Anshu Jamaiyar, Abhimanyu Shome
pmc-13176789.description: BackgroundLeukemia represents a significant and rising health burden in India. Despite this, a government-maintained population-based cancer registry is lacking in Jharkhand. This study aimed to characterizethe clinico-hematological and immunophenotypic profile of newly diagnosed leukemia cases from a tertiary care center in this underrepresented region.

pmc-13299105.title: Cold Scissors and Small Myotomy: A Laparoscopic Intracapsular Myomectomy Method for Women in Reproductive Age
pmc-13299105.creator: Eleni-Markella Chalkia-Prapa, Andrea Tinelli, Giovanni Pecorella, Panayotis Xiromeritis, Apostolos Mamopoulos, Nikos Prapas, Yannis Prapas
pmc-13299105.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Objectives:Authors evaluated the surgical outcomes of the “cold scissors” technique, focusing on minimal myotomy, during laparoscopic intracapsular myomectomies. The primary endpoints included the initial and final lengths of the uterine incision, as well as the duration of wound healing.Materials and Methods:The prospective observational cohort study was conducted from May 2017 to June 2022 on patients diagnosed with intramural fibroids (FIGO classifications 4–6), with fibroid sizes ranging from 4 to 10 cm in diameter.

pmc-13505196.creator: Xu Yang, Junshu Wang, Guoming Zhang, Zhaoyuan Yu
pmc-13505196.description: Respiratory diseases pose a serious threat to the health of residents in China and cause enormous socio‐economic losses. Jiangsu has a total of over 27 million vulnerable people in two groups: children under 15 years old and the elderly over 65 years old.

pmc-13520939.title: Potential pitfalls in diagnostic and therapeutic decision-making in pulmonary embolism-related obstructive shock in patients with cancer: a case report
pmc-13520939.creator: Tom Van den Hoek, Peter Kayaert, Eva De Caluwé, Philippe Timmermans
pmc-13520939.description: BackgroundPulmonary embolism (PE) is a potentially life-threatening condition and represents the third most common cardiovascular syndrome. Patients with cancer are at markedly increased risk of PE and often present with complex metabolic and haemodynamic alterations. Risk stratification in acute PE relies on clinical parameters, biomarkers, and imaging findings to guide therapeutic decisions.
